name: DeleteRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the authorization rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的授权规则所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host from which you want to delete the authorization rule.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除授权规则的堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the authorization rule that you want to delete.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758868.html operation to query the authorization rule ID
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的授权规则ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758868.html接口获取该参数
